flexible.maximum_residues_reason: A flexible linker has no geometric upper bound; extra length costs configurational entropy and loosens relative domain orientation, which this calculator does not score.

helical.maximum_residues_reason: A helical linker is modelled as a stiff rod: a rod longer than the window holds the two domains further apart than the chosen attachment points allow, which is a geometric failure in its own right.
